preservedResponsibilities: Original locale C-buffer facades use real normalized/subtag ByteSink operations and actual checked-array adaptation. Null locale default lookup remains before the shared incoming-error guard; keyword getter has a distinct null-locale contract elsewhere. Source language-only early-return and source GetAppendBuffer ISO alias writes, including bytes outside final appended length, are retained. Native facade comparison observes all physical guard bytes across capacity/status/default/NUL cases. Native invalid memory/capacity ranges, reverse conversion and full calendar/service integration remain uncertified.
omittedResponsibilities: Only the stated source responsibilities are ported; native pointer/allocator/ABI and complete locale/calendar integration remain uncertified.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original large uloc.cpp implementation is split by keyword/C-buffer API responsibility while sharing actual ByteSink and locale parser owners.
